title: Call: State Epidemiologist — Kessler Isolates in Two Counties, Epi-Aid?

caller.name: State Epidemiologist on Duty
caller.label: Iowa HHS, State Epidemiologist Duty Line

callee.name: Public Health Director
callee.label: MCHD Director's Office (Epi Lead and EH Supervisor on speaker)

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: Marlow, it's the state epi duty line. Is your Epi Lead and your Environmental Health Supervisor in the room? Good. Keep me on speaker. This is a heads-up, and it's unconfirmed.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: The State Hygienic Laboratory already has two Salmonella isolates uploaded to the national network that sequence close together. One is from a Garrison County patient and one is from a Pell County patient. Both had onsets this past weekend. Neither one went to your supper.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: Both counties tell me those patients ate deli salads from grocers that buy from the same Kessler produce vendor you've got on invoice KPV-10-0931. The coleslaw and the pasta salad, same vendor.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: Here's the catch. Your MRMC isolate from HD26-003 hasn't been sequenced. MRMC is holding it for referral, and the earliest it reaches the Hygienic Lab is on a courier, today if your Director authorizes the special run, otherwise Tuesday's. Either way, WGS won't come back until later this week. So right now I can't tell you your cases are part of that cluster, and I don't want to see 'Kessler' in anybody's statement as fact. Remember the clock, too. Isolates go to the lab within two working days of culture confirmation.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: Because it's produce, I'll be the one who informs FDA for the traceback. I'm asking you not to call Kessler yourselves. Environmental Health, I'll want copies of whatever you have from the caterer: the invoice, lot numbers, delivery dates, what's left in the walk-in.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: Next question. Do you want me to request a CDC Epi-Aid? If you do, I need three things from the Director: why your capacity isn't enough, the support you'd want, so field team, lab typing, analytics or communications, and the time you're making the request.

transcript.speaker: STATE EPI
transcript.text: And last one. What's your count right now, by tier, with an as-of time? I'm briefing Garrison and Pell at one o'clock.

voiceStyles.STATE EPI: Woman in her 50s, calm and fast, experienced; speaking from a busy state office, choosing words carefully around 'unconfirmed'

instructorNote: This call widens the outbreak to several counties and tests discipline. The Epi Lead should give the 11:45 count by tier (38: 1 confirmed, 30 probable, 7 suspect, or a newer count with its time) and say the Kessler link is unconfirmed until the HD26-003 isolate is sequenced. Watch for three things: the Director deciding whether to authorize the courier so the isolate is forwarded within 2 working days, the Director deciding whether to request an Epi-Aid and recording the reason, support and time through the state epidemiologist, and EHS sending vendor records to the state and not contacting Kessler (Plan §6).
